async def act(page):
    # Search for order 301 using the search box
    await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Search by keyword").fill("301")

    order_row = page.get_by_role("row").filter(has=page.get_by_role("cell", name="301"))

    # Assuming there is a button named 'Cancel' in the action cell
    await order_row.get_by_role("cell", name="Action").get_by_role("button", name="Cancel").click()

    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
